name: wishrnd_iwishrnd
expr: accW = zeros(2); for i=1:600; accW = accW + wishrnd(Sigma, df); end; Mw = accW / (600 * df); errW = max(max(abs(Mw - Sigma))); accI = zeros(2); for i=1:600; accI = accI + iwishrnd(Tau, df2); end; Mi = accI / 600 * (df2 - 3); errI = max(max(abs(Mi - Tau))); W = wishrnd(Sigma, df); sym = max(max(abs(W - W'))); detpos = double(det(W) > 0);
comment: Sig: W = wishrnd(Sigma, df) — Wishart RNG via Bartlett decomposition: factor Sigma = L·L', build lower-tri B with B(i,i)=sqrt(χ²(df-i)) and B(i,j)~N(0,1) for i>j, then W = (L·B)(L·B)'. W = iwishrnd(Tau, df) — sample Y ~ W(inv(Tau), df) via Bartlett, return inv(Y). Stochastic samples; fingerprint pins E[W]/df ≈ Sigma for Wishart, E[W]·(df-p-1) ≈ Tau for inverse Wishart, plus exact symmetry of a single draw and positive-definiteness. KNOWN GAPs: 3rd-argument D (pre-Cholesky), 2-output [W, D] form deferred.
